<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def heights(fr):
    a = fr.ascii.split('\n')
    hs={}
    for name,(c0,c1) in {'C1':(6,13),'C2':(16,25),'C3':(28,35),'C4':(38,47),'C5':(50,57)}.items():
        col=(c0+c1)//2
        top=None
        for r in range(64):
            if a[r][col]=='W': top=r; break
        hs[name]=58-top if top is not None else 0
    return hs
coords = {'D':(56,46),'C':(56,34),'B':(56,24),'A':(56,12)}
srcdst = {'A':('C2','C1'),'B':('C3','C2'),'C':('C4','C3'),'D':('C5','C4')}
plan = [('C',1),('D',1),('C',2),('B',5),('A',7)]
ok=True
for tower,cnt in plan:
    r,c = coords[tower]
    src,dst = srcdst[tower]
    for i in range(cnt):
        h0 = heights(current_frame)
        if h0[src] < 2:
            print("ABORT: source",src,"empty at",tower); ok=False; break
        action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':r,'col':c}])
        if last_action_result.get('level_completed') or last_action_result.get('done'):
            print("LEVEL DONE during",tower); ok=False; break
        h1 = heights(current_frame)
        if h1[src]!=h0[src]-2 or h1[dst]!=h0[dst]+2:
            print("MISMATCH at",tower,i,h0,h1); ok=False; break
    if not ok: break
print("final:", heights(current_frame), "ok:", ok, last_action_result.get('level_completed'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

def heights(fr):
    a = fr.ascii.split('\n')
    hs={}
    for name,(c0,c1) in {'C1':(6,13),'C2':(16,25),'C3':(28,35),'C4':(38,47),'C5':(50,57)}.items():

    return hs

    for i in range(cnt):

        action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':r,'col':c}])
